summary: Validated CEO Digital audit items 9 (source flag) + 10 (stale warning). 17/17 backend tests pass covering all 11 CEO endpoints, persistence verification, OpenAPI 3.1.0 schema, and edge cases (malformed DATA_SOURCE_MODE, missing _collected_at, source override). Source override scenario (DATA_SOURCE_MODE=test) manually verified via supervisor restart — decision_safe correctly becomes false. State restored to prod + fresh snapshot.

minor.issue: upsert_goal() does NOT refresh 'source' field on UPDATE path. Only sets fields from payload + updated_at. Existing seeded docs (from before fix) still carry legacy source='seed_metas_2026' and never get re-tagged. New docs work fine. If full audit compliance requires legacy goals also showing source='prod', add `set_doc['source'] = _dp.current_source()` in the if-existing branch of corporate_goals.upsert_goal().

action_items: OPTIONAL (minor): In corporate_goals.upsert_goal(), also tag set_doc['source'] = _dp.current_source() on UPDATE branch so legacy seed docs converge to current source on next write. Spec literal only mandates NEW docs persist source — current behavior is compliant.
OPTIONAL (hardening): Add a small migration to backfill source='prod' on existing corporate_goals where source matches legacy value 'seed_metas_2026'.
critical_code_review_comments: data_provenance.py is clean, small, well-encapsulated. decision_safe = (src=='prod') AND (not stale) is exactly the right semantic — Presidente IA cannot recommend on test/mock OR on stale prod data.
freshness_block correctly treats missing/malformed _collected_at as STALE (conservative) — verified by unit test.
OpenAPI 3.1.0 exposes 11 operations + DataProvenance schema. No regression vs previous iteration.
executive_memory.snapshot_today tags one_truth.source and root.source at both upsert phases — solid.
executive_decisions.create_decision persists 'source' on doc creation — verified end-to-end via list.
seed_data_creation: Test creates ephemeral decision (TEST_provenance_source_persist) and ephemeral goal (TEST_kpi_provenance) — the goal is cleaned up by the test itself; the decision persists harmlessly (priority p3, proposed_by presidente_ia).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_ceo_provenance.py is the regression suite for audit items 9+10. To re-run: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_ceo_provenance.py -v`. The stale-warning test mutates one_truth._collected_at via pymongo directly then calls POST /briefing/now to restore. If you change DATA_SOURCE_MODE in .env for testing, you MUST restart backend (sudo supervisorctl restart backend) AND restore to prod + run POST /briefing/now to refresh snapshot. Backend restart takes ~5s.

item9_source_flag.decisions_create: POST creates doc with source='prod' persisted in Mongo (verified via GET list)
item9_source_flag.goals_upsert_new: NEW doc via PUT carries source='prod' (verified)

source_override.DATA_SOURCE_MODE=test: VERIFIED via supervisor restart — source='test', decision_safe=false even when snapshot fresh (stale_warning=false). Restored to prod, snapshot refreshed, decision_safe back to true.
source_override.DATA_SOURCE_MODE=foo (malformed): Falls back to 'prod' (verified via unit test)

validations_performed.openapi: openapi=3.1.0, components.schemas.DataProvenance present with all 7 fields, 11 operations exposed (ceoBriefingToday, ceoBriefingNow, ceoMemory, ceoMetas, ctoSendMessage, ctoInbox, decisionsList, decisionsCreate, decisionsUpdate, goalsList, ctoDigest) — no regression
validations_performed.DATA_STALE_HOURS_override: Set to 1h, 2h-old data correctly flagged stale

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bugs. One minor improvement noted: upsert_goal doesn't refresh source on existing-doc update path, leaving legacy seed docs with old source='seed_metas_2026'. Spec wording 'Documentos novos ... persistem source=prod' is satisfied. Worth fixing in a small follow-up for full convergence.
